Closes #5735, refs #3007.

This makes the "Search everywhere" dialog in JetBrains IDEs movable. (Thanks @ammen99!)

issue_context.title: xwayland: listen to set_geometry event
issue_context.body:
References: https://github.com/swaywm/wlroots/pull/2431

X11 windows don't need to commit to update their geometry.

Right now we update the override-redirect window position on commit only. We should update it on `configure_notify`.

review_comments: Technically we don't need this anymore since wlroots already checks it.
